title: Run takeover
summary: Successor creation evaluates the older run through complete frozen QA selections. An incomplete historical selection refuses with reviewed operator repair recovery before resumption. Original source and target identities remain authoritative. A containing successor on the same flow and target takes over waiting members under existing QA and approval rules. Without shared QA or approval, a member stays in the old run only when its item QA passed and it can close there mid-run (final intent and nothing the done write would refuse); every other member, including a refused or non-final one, moves, so none is stranded in a run that cannot finish. Once creation commits, an older run left holding only those closed members finishes by itself through its ordinary succeeded close-out, even while the driver that took it over is still attached. While a live steering seat covers the project only the seat holder or the older run's creating session may take it over, live driver or not; other sessions are refused with takeover_reserved_for_steering and report the landing to steering. start-for-item creates, takes over, enrolls and validates in one transaction, so any refusal writes nothing and an item the takeover moved is enrolled once. Creation refuses up front when the caller's machine could not drive a self-deploy run. A takeover that aborts no running QA execution sends the owner no notice. When it aborts one, the waking notice names the new run and says to keep the claim and stay parked.
